title: An embedded submanifold is Borel and meets small closed balls in compact sets
statement: Let P, r, d ∈ ℕ and M ⊆ ℝ^P with IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M, i.e. every y ∈ M has open sets V ⊆ ℝ^d and W ⊆ ℝ^P with y ∈ W and a map ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P that is C^r on V and injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(v) injective for v ∈ V. Then (a) M is a (Borel) measurable subset of ℝ^P, and (b) every y ∈ M has some ε > 0 such that M ∩ closedBall(y, ε) is compact.
lean_statement: ∀ (P r d : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ∀ y ∈ M, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ IsCompact (M ∩ closedBall y ε)
